Notes

Captions: Anton, compressed 0.80, centred at 72.6% of frame height, same as your measured style. The spoken word gets a gold pill with dark type instead of turning gold, each line pops in with a small overshoot, and lines drop out during pauses over one second.

Scores are the local checker. They match the originals because the timelines are identical; every flag is about shot length in the source takes, not the grade or the captions.

Files are 2160×3840 at 29.97 fps, H.264 CRF 16 with no bitrate cap, loudness −14 LUFS. Import through the Instagram Edits app and export 4K there.
